threat_deck.name: War Rooms
threat_deck.text: Setup: build each threat deck from every Security and Universal threat of its tier and as many of its other threats, taken at random; shuffle it. The rest stay in the box.

rules.name: Commandeered Plants
rules.text: Every round, after last round's sites escalate: each factory not yet the adversary's that holds an Agent takes 1 more.

difficulty.text: When a threat executes uncountered, the adversary also gains 4 compute.

research.name: War Research
research.text: Every 2 cubes a country on the track (4 cubes with two countries, 6 with three) are spent to advance the marker one slot; the slot's icon happens once. Slot 7: the players lose.

icons.name: New factory
icons.text: Each country: a neutral factory opens on its lowest-numbered free industrial zone.

icons.name: New lab
icons.text: Each country: a neutral research station opens on its lowest-numbered empty station site.

icons.name: Funding
icons.text: Income: +1 compute a country a round.

icons.name: Botnet
icons.text: Botnets spread (level 1+): each country, a Botnet onto its lowest-numbered site without one next to one of its Botnets (a country with none: its lowest-numbered research station).

icons.name: Fallout
icons.glyph: Fallout glyph by a dark-framed city
icons.text: Each country: a Fallout lands next to its lowest-numbered corrupted city.

icons.name: Blackout
icons.glyph: city glyph with energy struck through
icons.text: Until the end of next round, cities make no energy and no Discord.

icons.name: Garrison
icons.text: Each country: 1 Troop garrisons its lowest-numbered corrupted factory (with none, its lowest-numbered corrupted city; with none, its lowest-numbered city).

icons.name: Strike
icons.text: Strike: each Troop destroys 1 player Node, research station or factory on or next to it.

icons.name: Redeploy
icons.glyph: troop with an arrow to a dark-framed city
icons.text: Redeploy: each Troop not on or next to a corrupted city moves onto the nearest corrupted city.

levels.name: Sleeper Cells
levels.rule: When an Agent lands on a city, it falls at 3 agents, not 5.

levels.name: War Footing
levels.flavor: Every unanswered strike feeds the war machine.
levels.rule: When a threat executes uncountered, the adversary also gains 4 compute.

levels.name: Arms Race
levels.flavor: The labs build weapons, not cures.

events.name: Probing Strikes
events.text: Threat, each country: a tier-1 threat. Infiltrate: coastal cities.

events.name: Factory Drive
events.text: Threat, each country: a tier-1 threat. Infiltrate: coastal cities. Each country: a neutral factory opens on its lowest-numbered free industrial zone.

events.name: Long Patrols
events.text: Threat, each country: a tier-1 threat. Infiltrate: cities. Botnets spread (level 1+): each country, a Botnet onto its lowest-numbered site without one next to one of its Botnets (a country with none: its lowest-numbered research station).

events.name: War Drums
events.text: Threat, each country: a tier-1 threat. Infiltrate: cities. Sway 1 toward Discord.

events.name: Signal Jamming
events.text: Threat, each country: a tier-1 threat. Infiltrate: botnet hexes. Income: +1 compute a country a round. Botnets spread (level 1+): each country, a Botnet onto its lowest-numbered site without one next to one of its Botnets (a country with none: its lowest-numbered research station).

events.name: Mobilization
events.text: Threat, each country: a tier-2 threat. Infiltrate: coastal cities. Strike: each Troop destroys 1 player Node, research station or factory on or next to it.

events.name: Station Raids
events.text: Threat, each country: a tier-2 threat. Infiltrate: research stations. Botnets spread (level 1+): each country, a Botnet onto its lowest-numbered site without one next to one of its Botnets (a country with none: its lowest-numbered research station).

events.name: Shell Labs
events.text: Threat, each country: a tier-2 threat. Infiltrate: research stations. Each country: a neutral research station opens on its lowest-numbered empty station site.

events.name: Fifth Column
events.text: Threat, each country: a tier-2 threat. Infiltrate: cities. Strike: each Troop destroys 1 player Node, research station or factory on or next to it. Botnets spread (level 1+): each country, a Botnet onto its lowest-numbered site without one next to one of its Botnets (a country with none: its lowest-numbered research station).

events.name: Border War
events.text: Threat, each country: a tier-2 threat. Infiltrate: factories. Each player with a Node on or next to a factory destroys 1 of those Nodes.

events.name: Supply Lines
events.text: Threat, each country: a tier-1 and a tier-2 threat. Infiltrate: factories. Income: +1 compute a country a round.

events.name: Redeployment
events.text: Threat, each country: a tier-2 threat. Infiltrate: cities. Redeploy: each Troop not on or next to a corrupted city moves onto the nearest corrupted city.

events.name: Total Mobilization
events.text: Threat, each country: 2 tier-2 threats. Infiltrate: factories. Infiltrate: cities. Strike: each Troop destroys 1 player Node, research station or factory on or next to it. Remove 2 Unity from the Unity track.

events.name: Blitzkrieg
events.text: Threat, each country: 2 tier-2 threats. Infiltrate: cities. Infiltrate: research stations. Strike: each Troop destroys 1 player Node, research station or factory on or next to it. Sway 1 toward Discord. Each country: 1 Fallout lands next to its lowest-numbered corrupted city.

events.name: Occupation
events.text: Threat, each country: 2 tier-2 threats. Infiltrate: research stations. Infiltrate: cities. Strike: each Troop destroys 1 player Node, research station or factory on or next to it. Redeploy: each Troop not on or next to a corrupted city moves onto the nearest corrupted city.

events.name: Naval Blockade
events.text: Threat, each country: 2 tier-2 threats. Infiltrate: coastal cities. Infiltrate: factories. Strike: each Troop destroys 1 player Node, research station or factory on or next to it. Until the end of next round, cities make no energy and no Discord. Each country: 1 Fallout lands next to its lowest-numbered corrupted city.
